subject: Post-call recap: Pilot governance, success gates & recommended eval route
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@aurelia-sys.com>, Elena Morgan <elena.morgan@aurelia-sys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call recap: Pilot governance, success gates & recommended eval route

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a proposed path for the pilot so we can get alignment and a firm kickoff date. I captured our action items below and a recommended evaluation approach (offline vs. shadow) with trade-offs.

Recap (key asks from your side)
- Primary goal: reduce manual triage for customer support snippets and improve suggested responses quality.
- Success metric priority: precision and reduction in time-to-first-suggested-reply.
- Compliance: your security team needs SOC 2 summary + data residency confirmation.
- Procurement: Elena will coordinate SOW and PO timing.

Proposed pilot structure / success gates
- Duration: 3 weeks total (2-week shadow + 1-week evaluation/fine-tune).
- Acceptance matrix (attached): must meet 3/4 gates to move to paid Pilot:
  1) Relevance precision >= 78% on sampled live queries (scored by Aurelia SMEs)
  2) Latency: median response time under 180ms, p95 under 450ms (end-to-end)
  3) No PII leakage on sampled outputs (manual spot check)
  4) Operational stability: error rate < 1% sustained across a week

Eval modality options (short):
- Offline (batch) evaluation
  Pros: fast, safe for initial metrics, can test many prompt variants without live risk
  Cons: may miss real traffic distribution and upstream preprocessing differences

- Online shadowing (recommended initial route)
  Pros: real traffic fidelity, surface integration issues early; helps validate latency and stability under production-like conditions
  Cons: requires lightweight traffic mirroring and routing; needs clear opt-out/PII handling

Our recommendation
- Start with a low-risk shadow run for 2 weeks (5–10% mirrored traffic, read-only, no user-facing changes) to validate operational and latency gates. Parallel offline batches will be used to exercise edge cases and tune prompts. If shadow passes acceptance criteria, we flip a controlled canary and discuss rollout details in the paid phase.

Owners and timeline
- Soojin (me): program owner / coordination, runbook and acceptance sign-off
- Karthik: integration lead (traffic mirroring, telemetry hooks)
- Marissa: success / rubric & scoring owner (SME human scoring plan)
- Proposed kickoff: Tue May 17 (we can shift one week if procurement requires it)

Attachments: pilot-charter-v0.1.pdf, acceptance-matrix.xlsx (detailed scoring rubrics included)

Next steps (please reply inline)
1) Confirm OK to start shadowing on May 17 or propose an alternate kickoff
2) Confirm any additional compliance questions (data residency, retention windows)
3) Share a sample of 200 anonymized queries for our offline baseline tests

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Soojin —

Thanks for the clear write-up. Shadowing sounds like the right first step to us; our compliance folks pushed for read-only mirror testing rather than any live writes, so your recommendation maps directly to that ask. A few clarifying items from our side:

- Compliance: can you send a SOC 2 summary (or link) and a short note about data residency — we need to confirm that mirrored payloads will stay in the US (our EU customers have separate handling).
- Dataset: we'll prepare ~200 anonymized historical support requests and aim to share them by end of week. Any preferred schema?
- Opt-out: we need a brief blurb for our privacy team describing how tokens/sensitive fields are stripped during mirroring.

Proposed kickoff: May 17 works for engineering — let's tentatively lock that and we'll confirm by EOD Wed once procurement gives a green-light.

Elena, will you coordinate SOW timing?

—Samir
Head of Product
Aurelia Systems

Looping in to confirm integration plan and dependencies.

Quick notes:
- I will own the mirroring implementation and telemetry (traces, token-level cost estimates, latency histograms).
- For the sample dataset, CSV with columns: request_id, timestamp, customer_tenant, text, metadata_json is ideal. If PII is a concern, send field mapping and we can provide a simple sanitizer script to run on your side.
- For shadow traffic, we will use our read-only mirroring pipeline; we need a URL endpoint and a small auth token TTL for initial testing — can Samir share a dev endpoint and who on your side owns it?

Action items from infra side (I will start these this week):
1) Prep mirror config + small test harness (expected 2–3 days)
2) Generate instrumentation checklist for your engineering (to validate telemetry)
3) Coordinate with Marissa on sampling plan for SME scoring

Thanks — will update in the shared drive folder once the harness is ready.

-Karthik
